name: Improved Monstrous Trip (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Trip

Benefit(s): After a successful use of the trip ability, you also immediately grapple your foe and do not draw an attack of opportunity as if your last trip also had the grab special attack (+4 bonus to the grapple check).
